newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Financial to buy mortgage company.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Financial to buy mortgage company.

text.p: Advanced Financial Inc, which provides residential mortgage banking services, said Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to purchase the assets of a privately-held California-based mortgage banking company.
Advanced Financial declined to identify the company.
The transaction will involve an exchange of Advanced Financial common stock, not to exceed 2.18 million shares, for assets valued at about $3 million.
Completion of the transaction is expected within 30 days, pending shareholder approval.

The acquired company currently originates about $25 million in mortgages per month through 15 offices in three states. The new combined company will originate an estimated $35 million in mortgages per month through 41 retail branches in 15 states, and will provide a strong base in the lucrative California market.
An Advanced Financial spokesman said that the company intends to maintain current staff levels at this time.
Advanced Financial said this acquisition is part of the company's strategic plan to grow its core business.
Advanced Financial shares were off 1/8 at 1-7/8.
